email_basis: The firm site publishes only a generic mailbox, info@familyofficeresearch.com; no individual/principal mailto is published on the site (no per-person team page with emails). Broker/aggregator listings excluded per rules.
signals: ~$648M AUM, 136 accounts (avg ~$4.8M); ~5 employees; owners Scott & Emily Freund; team incl. Sean McElhaney (VP, Wealth Advisor) and Morgan Freund (Financial Analyst); files quarterly 13F.
caveats: PLAINLY: this is a boutique fiduciary wealth-management RIA that uses 'family office' as branding, NOT a research/consulting firm (the name is misleading) and NOT a classic UHNW single/multi-family office. Average account size ~$4.8M across 136 accounts is more consistent with a HNW wealth-management practice than a genuine family office, so proof that it is a bona fide family office is insufficient. Founding year and 'multi-family office' label are inconsistent across sources.
